mapper.sql: kb.id, kb.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, kb.name, kb.description, kb.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document d WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id AND d.deleted = 0) AS documentCount, kb.created_at AS createdAt, kb.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = kb.user_id WHERE kb.deleted = 0 AND kb.id = #{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0) AS documentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_chunk WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}) AS chunkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0 AND parse_status = 'SUCCESS') AS completedDocuments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0 AND parse_status = 'FAILED') AS failedDocuments
